plan.summary: A compact two-day Taipei trip built around culture, landmarks and Taiwanese food. You arrive on the 16:45 flight and have a relaxed first evening: a floodlit walk at Liberty Square, then a calm Taiwanese dinner. Day two covers the National Palace Museum's Chinese art collection, a classic Taiwanese lunch, and the Taipei 101 Observatory for city views. An early dinner at Din Tai Fung leaves a comfortable buffer before the 21:15 flight home.
